module_summary: Wishbone PicoRV32 wrapper: a 3-state IDLE/WBSTART/WBEND FSM latches the picorv32 core's native bus request into registered Wishbone master outputs and returns ack data as mem_ready/mem_rdata.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Wishbone bridge FSM: launches cycle on mem_valid, waits ack, pulses mem_ready.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Core native bus request starting a Wishbone cycle from IDLE.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Registered one-cycle completion pulse back to the core on Wishbone ack.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Latches wbm_dat_i on ack and returns read data to the core.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Core request address, latched into wbm_adr_o.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Core store data, latched into wbm_dat_o.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Core byte strobes, latched into wbm_sel_o and ORed to form write flag.

anchors.name: we
anchors.why: Write flag decoded from any nonzero strobe, latched into wbm_we_o.

anchors.name: wbm_stb_o
anchors.why: Registered Wishbone strobe asserted from IDLE until ack.

anchors.name: wbm_ack_i
anchors.why: Wishbone ack ending the cycle, capturing read data and pulsing mem_ready.

anchors.name: wbm_adr_o
anchors.why: Registered Wishbone address latched from core mem_addr.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_o
anchors.why: Registered Wishbone write data latched from core mem_wdata.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_i
anchors.why: Wishbone read data captured into mem_rdata on ack.

anchors.name: wbm_we_o
anchors.why: Registered Wishbone write-enable selecting read or write cycle.

anchors.name: wbm_sel_o
anchors.why: Registered Wishbone byte selects from core strobes.

anchors.name: wbm_cyc_o
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle-valid, asserted together with stb.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Co-processor request passthrough from the core.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace stream valid passthrough from the core.

groups.name: cpu_core
groups.description: picorv32 core issuing native memory requests; PCPI/IRQ/trace passthrough.

groups.name: wishbone_bridge_fsm
groups.description: IDLE/WBSTART/WBEND FSM sequencing one Wishbone cycle per native request.

groups.name: wishbone_master_regs
groups.description: Registered Wishbone master outputs and ack-captured read data.
